title: Large-scale empirical tuning and comparison of default optimizers for variational inference
abstract: arXiv:2606.07841v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Black-box variational inference (BBVI) is a methodology for posterior approximation that relies on stochastic optimization. In practice, the stochastic optimizers underpinning BBVI generally require extensive problem-specific tuning, which undermines its promise as a truly "black box" inference algorithm. However, over the past decade, many new adaptive stochastic optimization algorithms have been developed that reduce or remove entirely the need for tuning. In this work, we investigate this new collection of adaptive methods in the context of BBVI, with the goal of establishing the current state of the art in tuning-free optimization-based inference. In particular, we present a large-scale empirical evaluation of 56 stochastic gradient-based optimization algorithms applied to 1092 Bayesian inference optimization problems, involving over 550,000 individual optimization runs and 15 core-years of compute. translated_title: 变分推断默认优化器的大规模实证调参与比较
translated_abstract: 黑箱变分推断（BBVI）是一种依赖随机优化的后验近似方法。在实践中，支撑BBVI的随机优化器通常需要针对具体问题进行大量调参，这削弱了其作为真正“黑箱”推断算法的承诺。然而，在过去十年中，许多新的自适应随机优化算法被开发出来，它们减少或完全消除了调参的需求。在这项工作中，我们在BBVI的背景下研究了这一系列新的自适应方法，旨在确立无调参的基于优化的推断方法的最新技术水平。特别是，我们对56种基于随机梯度的优化算法应用于1092个贝叶斯推断优化问题进行了大规模实证评估，涉及超过55万次单独的优化运行和15个核心年的计算量。
tldr: 本文通过对56种随机梯度优化算法在1092个贝叶斯推断问题上进行超55万次优化运行的大规模实证评估，系统比较了无调参自适应优化器在黑箱变分推断中的表现，确立了无调参优化推断的最新技术水平。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a large-scale empirical evaluation of 56 stochastic gradient-based optimizers across 1092 Bayesian inference problems involving over 550,000 optimization runs, systematically comparing tuning-free adaptive optimizers for black-box variational inference and establishing the state of the art in tuning-free optimization-based inference.
